source: Food Standards Agency food hygiene rating register
method: All establishments within 1 mile of each area, fully paginated, filtered to Restaurant/Cafe/Canteen / Takeaway/sandwich shop / Pub/bar/nightclub.
caveats: FSA cannot distinguish a cafe from a restaurant — both are Restaurant/Cafe/Canteen.
Hygiene ratings are deliberately not used: they say nothing about quality.
Shares describe balance and hide intensity — read them with `counts`.
